text:
Predicates:
Mammal(x) ::: x is a mammal.
HasTeeth(x) ::: x has teeth.

Premises:
∃x (Mammal(x) ∧ HasTeeth(x)) ::: Some mammals have teeth.
¬HasTeeth(platypus) ::: Platypus have no teeth.
Mammal(platypus) ::: Platypus are mammals.
HasTeeth(human) ::: Humans have teeth.

Conclusion:
Mammal(human) ::: Humans are mammals.
